gaps.sentence: We visited ___ Louvre on our last morning in Paris.
gaps.explanation: Most famous buildings and monuments take 'the': the Louvre, the Eiffel Tower.

gaps.sentence: He demands ___ answer before the end of the day.
I live on ___ Baker Street, near the tube station.
gaps.explanation: Street names take no article: Baker Street, Oxford Street.

gaps.sentence: ___ books you left on my desk were really useful.
gaps.explanation: 'The books you left…' — the clause identifies which books.

gaps.sentence: ___ Lake Constance lies between Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
gaps.explanation: Lakes take no article when 'Lake' comes first.

gaps.sentence: ___ rich variety of birds lives in the Danube delta.
gaps.explanation: A rich variety of… — variety is countable here, first mention.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ heir to a shipping fortune.
gaps.explanation: 'Heir' begins with a vowel sound — the h is silent.

gaps.sentence: ___ spaceship travelled for six months before reaching Mars.
gaps.explanation: The spaceship — the one in the story; Mars takes no article.
